summary: Comprehensive testing of contribution descriptions feature for 4Luis crowdfunding platform. All features working correctly: CheckoutModal shows contribution descriptions next to amounts (€10-€1000), Admin panel has edit section with 7 input fields, backend APIs return contribution_descriptions field.
passed_tests: Backend: /api/homepage/main-journey returns contribution_descriptions field
Backend: /api/journeys/journey_china001 returns contribution_descriptions with 7 values
Backend: Journeys without descriptions (Japan) return null contribution_descriptions
Backend: Admin can read journeys with contribution_descriptions
Backend: Admin can update contribution_descriptions via PUT endpoint
Backend: Admin can update with partial/empty contribution_descriptions
Backend: Journey model includes contribution_descriptions field
Frontend: Homepage sticky bar opens CheckoutModal with descriptions
Frontend: CheckoutModal shows €10 description 'Um café com vista para a Grande Muralha'
Frontend: CheckoutModal shows €20 description 'Um almoço numa pequena cidade chinesa'
Frontend: CheckoutModal shows €50 description 'Uma noite de alojamento'
Frontend: CheckoutModal shows €100 description 'Uma viagem de comboio entre cidades'
Frontend: CheckoutModal shows €200 description 'Explorar um parque natural chinês'
Frontend: CheckoutModal shows €500 description 'Vários dias de descoberta cultural'
Frontend: CheckoutModal shows €1000 description 'Um grande impulso para este sonho'
Frontend: Selected amount (€10) shows white text with checkmark icon
Frontend: Unselected amounts show grey text for descriptions
Frontend: Journey detail page /journey/journey_china001 passes contribution_descriptions to CheckoutModal
Frontend: Japan journey (no descriptions) shows amounts only without description text
Frontend: Admin panel Journeys tab loads correctly
Frontend: Admin edit form shows 'Descrições de Contribuição' section header
Frontend: Admin edit form has 7 input fields for €10, €20, €50, €100, €200, €500, €1000
Frontend: Admin edit form displays current values in contribution description inputs
critical_code_review_comments: CheckoutModal correctly receives contributionDescriptions prop and conditionally renders descriptions
Selected amount styling uses bg-[#FFBE98] with white text, unselected uses grey text (#6B6661)
Fallback behavior correct - amounts without descriptions show only euro value
Backend Journey model properly defines contribution_descriptions as Optional[dict]
JourneyUpdate model includes contribution_descriptions field for admin updates
Admin.js edit form uses data-testid for each amount input for testability
seed_data_creation: China journey (journey_china001) already has contribution_descriptions seeded via MongoDB
context_for_next_testing_agent: Contribution descriptions feature fully tested. China journey is the main journey with descriptions for all 7 amounts (€10-€1000). Other journeys (Japan, Vietnam, Paris, London) do NOT have descriptions and correctly fallback to showing amounts only. Admin can edit descriptions via Journeys tab → Edit button → scroll to 'Descrições de Contribuição' section.

fallback_without_descriptions.behavior: Shows only euro values without description text
